items.title: EXE Q3 deep dive: Integration, new CEO, and commercial expansion define the quarter
items.summary: Natural gas producer Expand Energy (NASDAQ:EXE) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 11.6% year on year to $2.81 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.46 per share was 10.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Expand Energy (EXE) Tied To Record US Gas Demand From LNG And AI Data Centers
items.summary: Expand Energy (NasdaqGS:EXE) is linked to a forecast for record U.S. natural gas production as demand builds from new uses. Industry projections highlight LNG exports and power needs from AI data centers as key drivers behind the expected production records. Analysts describe a shift toward a demand pull market for U.S. gas, with Expand Energy positioned as a major North American producer.
